newsitem.title: USA: Computer Products says plans RTP Corp sale.
newsitem.headline: Computer Products says plans RTP Corp sale.

text.p: Computer Products Inc said Thursday it plans to divest its industrial automation division, RTP Corp, in order to concentrate on the communications business.
Accordingly, Computer products has classified RTP as a discontinued operation and recorded an after-tax non-recurring charge of $2.1 million, or $0.08 per share, against first quarter 1997 earnings.
Included in the charge is a writedown of RTP assets to their anticipated realizable value and expected operating losses until the division is sold, it said.
Computer Products said the communications industry accounted for nearly 75 percent of its 1996 sales of $222.5 million.
Computer Products said it is currently in discussions with several potential buyers and expects to sell the business by the end of the year.
